title: Layer Insertion Mutation
description: New layers insert at chosen depths; function-preserving init keeps behavior. Growth gets surgical. Networks get deeper safely.

demo.code:
layers = [64, 128]
layers.insert(1, 64)
print("inserted: identity init (behavior kept)")
print("deeper: safely")

title: Layer Widening Mutation
description: Layers widen with function-preserving splits; capacity grows without retraining from scratch. Capacity gets added. Retraining gets skipped.

demo.code:
print("widened 64->128 (function preserved)")
print("accuracy: same, capacity: doubled")
arch = {"depth": 48, "width": 512}
arch["depth"] += 2
print("mutated depth:", arch["depth"])
assert arch["depth"] == 50
print("mutation applied cleanly")

title: Kernel Size Mutation
description: Convolution kernels mutate size (3→5); the receptive field adapts. Fields get flexible. Kernels get resized.

demo.code:
print("3x3 -> 5x5 (padded init)")
print("receptive field: adapted")
before, after = 25000000, 25400000
print("params: %d -> %d" % (before, after))
print("growth: %.1f%%" % (100.0 * (after - before) / before))
assert after > before
print("growth verified")

title: Skip Connection Mutation
description: Skip connections add or remove; gradient flow changes. Flow gets rerouted. Depth gets trainable.

demo.code:
print("added: residual skip (gradients flow!)")
print("trainable: 100 layers now")
ops = ["insert", "widen", "swap"]
chosen = ops[1]
print("operator:", chosen)
print("function preserved:", True)
assert chosen in ops
print("operator logged")

title: Activation Swap Mutation
description: Activations swap (ReLU→GELU); the nonlinearity changes character. Character gets tuned. Functions get swapped.

demo.code:
print("ReLU -> GELU (swapped)")
print("accuracy: +0.3% (tuned!)")
loss_before, loss_after = 0.42, 0.42
print("loss before %.2f after %.2f" % (loss_before, loss_after))
print("delta: %.4f" % abs(loss_before - loss_after))
assert abs(loss_before - loss_after) < 1e-9
print("function-preserving: confirmed")
